text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, neutropenia, monocytosis, basophilia, elevated erythrocytes, high ferritin, increased creatinine, mild hyperchloremia, and a significantly elevated INR. These findings may indicate impaired oxygenation, possible bone marrow suppression or infection, renal dysfunction, and a coagulopathy. Further clinical correlation and urgent evaluation are recommended, especially regarding respiratory, renal, and hematologic status.
